app._comment: Used by explore-live-app.md for browser-driven exploration. baseUrls mirror cypress.config.js environments.local; credentials are read from envFile, never hardcoded.

testLimits._comment: Per SPEC FILE targets — multi-layer tickets get multiple spec files instead of dropped coverage (see create-ui-automated-test-cases.md)

runCommand._comment: The `fnm use 20 && unset ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE` prefix is REQUIRED: Cypress fails to bootstrap under the harness default (Node 18 + ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1). Do not remove it. See CLAUDE.md 'Running tests'.
runCommand.headed: fnm use 20 && unset ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE && npx cypress run --spec "{specFile}" --headed --reporter mochawesome
runCommand.headless: fnm use 20 && unset ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE && npx cypress run --spec "{specFile}" --reporter mochawesome
runCommand.withEnv: fnm use 20 && unset ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE && CYPRESS_ENV={env} npx cypress run --spec "{specFile}" --reporter mochawesome

productCode._comment: rootPaths MUST be overridden in .claude/project-config.local.json with your local repo paths

postman._comment: Whiz auth is cookie-based: POST /session (sets session cookie), then GET /api/session to read the gorilla CSRF token for mutations. Phizz uses server-to-server /auth + a Phizz-Checksum header (see cypress/support/commands.js).
